**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** Annual philosophy journal (Brill), the official organ of the International Johann Gottlieb Fichte Society, continued as a standalone journal from Vol. 50 (2021) after being a book series since 1990/relaunched 2014. Publishes exclusively scholarship on Johann Gottlieb Fichte's philosophy (transcendental philosophy, Wissenschaftslehre/system-building, textual-historical and reception-historical work). Not a general philosophy venue.

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** History-of-philosophy textual/exegetical analysis of Fichte's works, Systematic reconstruction/interpretation of Fichte's Wissenschaftslehre, Reception-history and comparative studies (Fichte and Kant, German Idealism, later philosophy), Themed/edited-volume contributions on specific Fichte texts (e.g. Vol. 49, 'The Enigma of Fichte's First Principles')
